name: Spread the Word
summary: Clubtoe asks you to bring Chogg'Zac's head to Tran'gul in Rog'mar after he leaves the Twilight's Hammer. Word of the defection may lead to more of the cult's ogres breaking free.

sections.title: A Message for Tran'gul
sections.body: Chogg'Zac's head is to go back to your friends, and Tran'gul in Rog'mar is the one to receive it. Clubtoe says he is done with the Twilight's Hammer and plans to join Clugfist, the biggest ogre he knows, with many others. Clubtoe means to stay where he is until the coast is clear. Now Tran'gul must hear what Clubtoe has chosen.

sections.title: News from the Cave
sections.body: Tran'gul hears that the cave held another surprise. You have convinced one of the Twilight's Hammer ogres to defect, and he spoke of others of his kind. Tran'gul says they must act on this news at once.

faq.answer: Clubtoe is an ogre who says he is done with the Twilight's Hammer and plans to join the free ogres.
Clugfist is the biggest ogre Clubtoe knows, and Clubtoe says he left the Twilight's Hammer with many friends.

faq.q: What does Clubtoe ask me to bring?
faq.answer: Clubtoe asks you to take Chogg'Zac's head back to his friends.

faq.q: Where do I take Chogg'Zac's head?
faq.answer: You are to deliver Chogg'Zac's head to Tran'gul in Rog'mar.
Tran'gul learns that one Twilight's Hammer ogre has defected and mentioned others of his kind.

attribution: In-game quest text: Spread the Word
